spec.name: Furniture Mini Graveyard
spec.description: A compact mossy graveyard tile with two stepped weathered gravestones, an emerging ivory skeletal hand, a ribbed orange pumpkin and a splintered wooden stake. Front faces negative Z; no inscriptions.

prompt: Create an original vanilla Minecraft furniture model: compact front-garden graveyard scene on a very thin mossy ground tile: two weathered gravestones, ivory skeletal hand emerging, small orange pumpkin and a broken wooden stake; no readable text. Grounded attractive survival-server furniture. Entire model fits x=0..32, y=0..16, z=0..32; floor y=0, front negative Z. 16 units per Minecraft block. Standing on floor y=0. Keep a 0.25-unit margin at outer x/z edges.  Use 8-30 purposeful axis-aligned cuboids, no rotations, no bones, no animation. Detailed hand-painted pixel art, coherent palette, explicit non-overlapping cube-net UVs with correct texel density. Connected physical structure, no z fighting, no stand outside the furniture. No text labels, no surrounding scene. Generate the whole piece with its distinctive silhouette and materials.
